title: Data center backlash is uniting America
script:
Data centers are sparking fierce local opposition across communities nationwide in the midterms.
The rapid buildout of massive server storage facilities is driving the local pushback.
Voters are activating against the massive infrastructure construction and expenses coming with them.
This sudden expansion has turned into a major issue in many congressional races.
Communities are raising serious concerns over heavy energy consumption and local grid strains.
Local residents demand stricter regulations on massive new tech real estate projects.
Would you want a massive facility built near your town?
